example.spec_text: COMMERCIAL PAYER CLINICAL POLICY BULLETIN (CPB-0742): Lumbar Laminotomy (CPT 63030) and Arthroscopic Meniscectomy (CPT 29881) require 6 weeks of documented supervised physical therapy, NSAID trial, and MRI confirming nerve root compression. ERISA appeal deadline is 180 calendar days under 29 CFR 2560.503-1.
